post.description: Matches each code (product identifier, SKU or barcode) to one product. Codes matching several products are returned as ambiguous, unknown codes as unmatched. Read-only; pass the matched ids as scopeProductIds.

post.summary: Append EPCs to a reconciliation session
post.description: Adds scanned EPC codes to an existing reconciliation session. Returns the updated remaining worklist by default, or a lightweight acknowledgement when responseMode=ack.

post.description: Adds a manually checked quantity or weighed quantity for products that cannot be scanned by EPC.

patch.summary: Add, remove or exclude products on an in-progress audit
patch.description: Spot check (scopeType='products'): edits the product list. Whole warehouse: removeProductIds / removeCategoryIds exclude products (they leave the worklist and finalize never adjusts them) and addProductIds re-includes excluded ones. Removing a product that already has a scanned EPC or manual count is rejected unless discardCounts (tenant opt-in). Every change is written to the activity log. Warehouse access is asserted in the service against the loaded session, so no @EnforceWarehouseScope decorator applies to this id-only route.

post.summary: Recount part or all of an in-progress audit
post.description: Clears scanned EPCs and manual counts. Omit productIds (or send []) to clear the whole session; name products to clear only the evidence attributed to them (unknown EPCs are kept). Bumps resetVersion and broadcasts recon-reset. Warehouse access is asserted in the service against the loaded session, so no @EnforceWarehouseScope decorator applies to this id-only route.

get.summary: One product's tags in an audit: which are still unread
get.description: Lists the product's live in-warehouse tags (unscanned first) flagged scanned or not, with last-seen location, plus over-count EPCs. Closed sessions answer from the frozen detail row.

get.summary: History of one audit session
get.description: Activity log rows written for this reconciliation (scope changes and exclusions, recounts, finalize and skipped adjustments, cancel, revert), newest first. Readable with stock.reconcile so counters do not need activity.view. Warehouse access is asserted in the service against the loaded session.

get.summary: Export an audit as a spreadsheet (any status)
get.description: One row per product (expected, counted split RFID/manual, missing, extra, status, locations; optional missing/extra EPC columns). Excel adds an unknown-tags sheet and a summary sheet; CSV carries the main table only. In-progress sessions export the live worklist, closed ones the frozen details. layout=minutes returns the Mẫu 05-VT stock count minutes (xlsx) with a one-row-per-EPC sheet.

post.summary: Finalize a reconciliation session
post.description: Completes the reconciliation by comparing scanned EPCs with stock quantities and optionally adjusting stock. This should be called when scanning is done.

get.summary: Get a specific stock reconciliation by ID
get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific stock reconciliation including all product-level details. Pass omitScannedEpcs=true to drop the session-level raw scan list from the response — it can be megabytes on large audits and only the mobile scanner needs it (to prime its captured-EPC set).

patch.description: Approve a completed reconciliation. Stock adjustment must be selected during finalize so approval cannot duplicate ledger movements.

post.summary: Cancel a stock reconciliation
post.description: Mark a reconciliation as cancelled from any non-terminal status. Reverses every stock-ledger entry the reconciliation wrote (both finalize-phase and approve-phase) by appending negated rows; the original entries are never deleted. Requires a reason (≥10 chars).

post.summary: Revert a stock reconciliation one step backward
post.description: approved → completed (reverses approve-phase ledger only) OR completed → in_progress (reverses finalize-phase ledger and wipes detail rows so re-finalize gets a fresh ERP baseline). Returns 400 from any other starting status. Requires a reason (≥10 chars).

`id` is the order id, its order code (orderNumber) or the id another system gave it (externalOrderId). `source` narrows the last to one channel; an external id several channels share is 409 ORDER_REF_AMBIGUOUS (params `ref`, `sources`).

post.summary: Record a payment on an order
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

Books a payment taken outside (cash, transfer, card, e-wallet) on a PENDING or CART order and confirms it at once: CASH on the CASH gateway, the rest on MANUAL. `amount` defaults to the remaining due; once payments cover the total the order is marked paid. Acts as the key's owner (needs `transaction.create`). Send an `Idempotency-Key` to make retries safe. Returns the completed transaction.

`id` is the order id, its order code (orderNumber) or the id another system gave it (externalOrderId). `source` narrows the last to one channel; an external id several channels share is 409 ORDER_REF_AMBIGUOUS (params `ref`, `sources`).

post.summary: Sync a completed sale from another system
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

Books a sale that already happened in a third-party POS and deducts its stock in the same call: the order is completed (DONE) and each EPC's tag is marked SOLD. Lines name the product by `productId`, `sku` (SKU or barcode) or `epc`; `epcs` is a shortcut for EPC-only sales. `unitPrice` is optional (catalog price) and may be 0; `payments` may be empty. Idempotent per `externalOrderId`: re-sending returns the existing order with `created: false` and deducts nothing.

put.summary: Create or update an order by its external id
put.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

Creates a SALE with source API and status PROCESSING: stock is reserved, not deducted, and the ERP becomes the order's lifecycle authority. A later PUT patches customer, notes and shipping; changed lines are accepted until PICKED_UP (no pick list, nothing paid) and replace the order: the previous one is cancelled and its id returned as `replacedOrderId`. Identical lines are a no-op. Each line names its product by exactly one of `productId` and `sku`; `taxRate` is accepted but the line tax follows the tenant's rule. Response `{created, order}`; 409 `EXTERNAL_ORDER_NOT_EDITABLE` with `params.reason` (status, paid, pick_list).

SUBMITTED or IN_TRANSIT -> COMPLETED: the stock arrives at the destination. `items[{itemId, receivedQuantity, receivedEpcs?, shortfallResolution?}]` records a partial receipt. A line without EPCs received short needs `shortfallResolution` (`return_to_source` credits the missing quantity back to the source cells; `write_off` books it as a `lost` stock-out at the source), on the line or as the request-level `shortfallResolution`; otherwise 400 `STOCK_TRANSFER_SHORTFALL_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED`.

post.summary: Cancel a stock transfer
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

Body `{reason?}`. A submitted or in-transit transfer returns its stock to the source; a completed one cannot be cancelled.

get.summary: List stock reconciliations (or a delta page)
get.description: Filters `status`, `warehouseId` (and in the page shape `scopeType`, `startDate`, `endDate`). With `updatedSince` (RFC 3339) or `cursor` the response is `{ data, nextCursor, serverTime }` ordered by `(updatedAt, id)`, `limit` 1..500 (default 100), and each row is the full `GET /:id` body. Without them the list keeps its page shape.

get.summary: Get a stock reconciliation with its details
get.description: The session and its per-product details, without the raw scan list.

post.summary: Push an order to a linked workspace (hub)
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

Body `{linkId, warehouseId, currency?, notes?, expectedAt?, lines:[{productId, quantity, unit?, unitPrice, taxRate?}]}` (1 to 500 lines). Creates the order (origin `seller`, accepted) with a draft sale shipment from `warehouseId` and sends it to the linked workspace, which books it as a confirmed purchase order (automatically when every line maps and the link has a receiving warehouse). The shipment can be dispatched once the store acknowledged (409 `INTER_TENANT_ORDER_AWAITING_BUYER` before). Returns `{id, shipmentId}`. Runs as the key's owner.

get.summary: List the linked stores an order can be pushed to, with their linkId and Buymed customerId (hub)
List a linked store's receiving warehouses (hub): ids and codes for targetWarehouseId / targetWarehouseCode
List orders between workspaces, newest first
get.description: Incoming orders (`direction=inbound`, the default) are purchase orders linked workspaces sent this workspace; `direction=outbound` lists the orders this workspace sent. Filters: `status` (`pending`, `accepted`, `rejected`, `cancelled`, `shipped` for incoming; `sent`, `accepted`, `rejected`, `cancelled`, `shipped`, `received` for sent), `q` (PO number or workspace), `page`, `pageSize` (max 200). Returns `{items, total, pendingCount}`.

get.summary: Order detail with lines, shipments and timeline
get.description: Lines carry the buyer's product record (`product`), the mapped local product (`productId`, `mappedProduct`), the buyer's quantity, unit and unit cost, and once accepted the shipment quantity in local units (`localQuantity`, `localUnit`, `localUnitPrice`) and what was dispatched so far (`shippedQuantity`).

get.summary: Receipt records (discrepancies) of an order
get.description: One record per received shipment, newest first: `{shipmentNumber, onMissing, orderStatus, expectedQuantity, receivedQuantity, missingQuantity, unexpectedEpcs, unexpectedUnitUids, truncated, lines:[{lineId, orderLineId, purchaseOrderItemId, productId, productTitle, unit, expected, received, missing, missingEpcs, missingUnitUids}], receivedAt, receivedByName}`. Both sides keep a copy (the hub's comes from the store).

post.summary: Receive a shipment of a purchase order's order by scan
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

`{id}` is the store's order (`GET /purchase-orders/{id}/inter-tenant`). Body `{shipmentId, epcs?, unitUids?, lines?:[{lineId, receivedQuantity}], onMissing: keep_open|close_short, warehouseId?}`. Tagged lines receive exactly the scanned units (EPC, or the unit UID printed on its label); untagged lines take `receivedQuantity` (default the shipped quantity). `keep_open` leaves the purchase order open for the missing units; `close_short` closes it with its variance (400 `INTER_TENANT_SHIPMENT_RECEIPT_INVALID` `other_shipments_open` while another linked shipment is open). Unexpected scans are recorded, never stocked. A pending shipment is accepted first into `warehouseId` or the purchase order's warehouse. Returns the receipt record; the hub is told.

post.summary: Accept an incoming order into a draft shipment
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

Body `{warehouseId, notes?, lines?:[{lineId, productId}]}`: optional line mappings first (remembered for the next orders), then every line must be mapped (400 `INTER_TENANT_ORDER_UNMAPPED_LINES`) and the link active and allowing sales (409 `INTER_TENANT_ORDER_LINK_NOT_ACTIVE`). Creates a draft sale shipment from `warehouseId` to the buyer with every line in local units, carrying the buyer's PO number, and tells the buyer. Returns `{id, shipmentId}`; dispatch the shipment with the internal shipments API or the web app. Runs as the key's owner (warehouse access to `warehouseId`).

post.summary: Reject an incoming order
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

Body `{reason}` (required, up to 500 characters). The buyer's purchase order is cancelled (its payable reversed) unless something was already received against it. Returns `{id}`.

post.summary: Attach EPCs in stock to the order's draft shipment (hub, write scope)
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

`{id}` is the hub's order (the `id` `POST /push` returns). Body `{epcs: string[] (1..5000), remove?: string[]}`. Each EPC must be a tag in stock (`active` or `found`) at the order's warehouse, of an order line's product, in that line's unit (the tag's sales unit, else the base unit). Attached EPCs move one unit each from the line's untagged quantity to its tagged quantity. `remove` takes EPCs off the draft. Answers `{shipmentId, attached, results: [{epc, attached, reason?}]}` in request order; reasons: `not_found`, `not_in_stock`, `wrong_warehouse`, `not_on_order`, `unit_mismatch`, `no_room`, `already_attached`. 409 `INTER_TENANT_ORDER_NO_DRAFT` when the order has no open draft (`POST /{id}/shipments` drafts the remainder).

post.summary: Dispatch the order's draft shipment (hub, write scope)
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

`{id}` is the hub's order. Body `{shipmentId?}`: the order's open draft when omitted, else that outbound shipment of the order (404 `INTER_TENANT_SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND` otherwise). Stocks out the shipment and sends it to the store, as the web's Dispatch does. A pushed order the store has not acknowledged yet is 409 `INTER_TENANT_ORDER_AWAITING_BUYER`. Answers the order.

post.summary: Draft a shipment for what the order still lacks (hub, write scope)
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

`{id}` is the hub's order. Drafts the quantities not shipped yet (after a partial dispatch, or units the store reported missing). 409 `INTER_TENANT_ORDER_INVALID_STATE` while a draft is open. Answers `{id, shipmentId}`.

post.summary: Accept an order the hub pushed (store, write scope)
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

`{id}` is the store's order (`GET /inter-tenant-orders?direction=outbound`). Body as `POST /{id}/accept`: `{warehouseId, mappings?}`. Books the store's confirmed purchase order and tells the hub. Orders whose lines all map and whose link has a default receiving warehouse are accepted automatically.

post.summary: Decline an order the hub pushed (store, write scope)
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

`{id}` is the store's order. Body `{reason}`. Cancels the store's purchase order and tells the hub; refused once a linked shipment was accepted or the purchase order received anything.

get.summary: List refunds across orders (Δ)
get.description: `page`/`pageSize` list, newest first, each refund with its lines. Refunds are immutable, so the delta list orders by `createdAt`. With `updatedSince` or `cursor` the answer is the delta shape `{data, nextCursor, serverTime}` ordered by (updatedAt, id); `limit` 1..500 (default 100).

get.summary: List pick lists (Δ)
get.description: Filters `status` and `orderId`; `limit`/`offset` paging. With `updatedSince` or `cursor` the answer is the delta shape `{data, nextCursor, serverTime}` ordered by (updatedAt, id); `limit` 1..500 (default 100). Delta items are full pick lists, as `GET /pick-lists/{id}` returns them.

post.summary: Create a pick list for an order
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

Body `{orderId, warehouseId?}`. The order must be pickable (a pickable status and delivery method, a warehouse).

get.summary: Get a pick list by id
get.description: The pick list with its warehouse, order and lines (with their bin locations).

post.summary: Cancel a draft or open pick list
post.description:
Requires an API key with the `write` scope.

Body `{reason?}`.

get.summary: List delivery notes (Δ)
get.description: Filters `status` and `orderId`; `limit`/`offset` paging. With `updatedSince` or `cursor` the answer is the delta shape `{data, nextCursor, serverTime}` ordered by (updatedAt, id); `limit` 1..500 (default 100). Delta items are full delivery notes.

get.summary: Get a delivery note by id
get.description: The delivery note with its lines and stock locations.

get.summary: List payment transactions (Δ)
get.description: `page`/`pageSize` list of completed transactions (or `status`), newest first. Each transaction carries the ids of the orders it pays (`orderIds`). With `updatedSince` or `cursor` the answer is the delta shape `{data, nextCursor, serverTime}` ordered by (updatedAt, id); `limit` 1..500 (default 100). The delta list covers every transaction.

get.summary: Get a transaction by id
get.description: The transaction with its linked `orderIds`.

get.summary: List POS sessions (Δ)
get.description: `page`/`pageSize` list, newest start first. With `updatedSince` or `cursor` the answer is the delta shape `{data, nextCursor, serverTime}` ordered by (updatedAt, id); `limit` 1..500 (default 100).

get.summary: Get a POS session by id
get.description: The cash session: opening cash, expected and counted closing cash, discrepancy.

get.summary: Deleted and archived records (delta sync)
get.description: Activity-log rows whose action ends in `.deleted`, `.archived` or `.removed`, for the target types `product`, `category`, `customer`, `supplier`, `warehouse`, `tag` and `purchase_order`, oldest first. Pass `since` (RFC 3339) or the previous page's `nextCursor`; `limit` is 1..500 (default 100). The answer is `{ data: [{ targetType, targetId, action, occurredAt }], nextCursor, serverTime }`.

get.summary: Describe the calling API key
get.description: Key id, name, scopes and expiry; the owner writes are credited to, with `canWrite` false when that user is deactivated or suspended (writes then answer 403 `API_KEY_OWNER_MISSING`); the per-minute rate limit (`null` unlimited) and the `X-Nwc-Source` this call carried. Use it to check a key when setting up an integration.

post.summary: Ask the tenant to approve a charge
post.description: Creates a pending charge (kind recurring, usage or one_time; amounts in VND). Send the admin to confirmationUrl: the charge starts only when an admin approves it there. A usage charge needs cappedAmount and terms. 400 APP_CHARGE_INVALID names the field.

get.summary: The calling app's charges
get.description: Every charge the app asked for, newest first, with its status.

get.summary: One of the calling app's charges
get.description: 404 APP_CHARGE_NOT_FOUND for another app's charge.

post.summary: Cancel a charge
post.description: Ends an active charge (a pending one is declined).

post.summary: Record usage on a usage charge
post.description: Adds a usage line to an active usage charge. 400 APP_USAGE_CAP_EXCEEDED when the month's total would pass cappedAmount; an idempotencyKey makes a retry answer the first record.

get.summary: List metaobjects of a type
get.description: type is one of the app's own types (as named in its manifest) or one of the shop's types (needs metaobjects:read).

get.description: Needs read scope on the owner type.

put.summary: Set one of the shop's custom field values
put.description: Needs write scope on the owner type; null clears the value.

put.summary: Report the calling app's status
put.description: Stores the app's health for the tenant's admin (shown on the app's page): `state` ok|warning|error (default ok), `message` (at most 500 characters, plain text), `moduleVersion` and `platformVersion` (at most 64; absent keeps the last ones) and `counters` (at most 20 keys `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,39}$`; numbers, booleans, null or strings up to 100 characters). Each call replaces the last report. 400 APP_STATUS_INVALID names the field; any other key gets 404 APP_NOT_FOUND.

get.summary: The calling app's installation
get.description: The installation behind an app key: handle, version, status and granted scopes. Any other key gets 404 APP_NOT_FOUND.

get.summary: The calling app's settings
get.description: Every setting value of the calling app's installation, secret fields included.

put.summary: Change the calling app's settings
put.description: Validates `values` against the manifest's settings schema (absent keeps a value, null clears it) and answers every value. 400 APP_SETTINGS_INVALID names the field.

get.summary: The calling app's metafields on a product, customer or order
get.description: Values of the calling app's own metafield definitions (namespace app--<handle>) on one owner. Needs read scope on the owner type.

put.summary: Set one of the calling app's metafields
put.description: Writes a value of a metafield the app's manifest defines (null deletes it). The value must fit the definition's type. 400 METAFIELD_NOT_DEFINED or METAFIELD_VALUE_INVALID; 404 METAFIELD_OWNER_NOT_FOUND.

post.summary: Report a shipment's status (app carriers)
post.description: The parcel's state now, from the carrier app that created it. Applied once per eventId (a repeat answers the first result). 404 APP_PROVIDER_TARGET_NOT_FOUND for a shipment of another carrier.

post.summary: Report a payment event (app gateways)
post.description: completed (with the amount paid) or failed, for a session the app opened. Applied once per eventId. When the gateway declares a status endpoint, core asks it before it completes anything.

post.summary: Report an e-invoice result (app e-invoice providers)
post.description: issued (with the invoice number and series) or failed, for an invoice the app answered pending. Applied once per refId and status.

put.summary: Create or update the app's channel order by its external id
put.description: Idempotent upsert keyed by (app, externalId). Lines map by exactly one of productId, sku, barcode or externalProductId (+ externalVariantId, the app's own catalog links); unknown products answer 400 CHANNEL_ORDER_LINES_UNMAPPED {lines: [{index, reason, ...}]} and write nothing. Prices are taken as given; a sent totalAmount must match (400 CHANNEL_ORDER_TOTAL_MISMATCH). Status moves only forward. Lines change only before stock is held or a pick list exists (409 CHANNEL_ORDER_NOT_EDITABLE). A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

get.summary: The app's channel order by its external id
get.description: 404 CHANNEL_ORDER_NOT_FOUND when the app has no such order. A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

put.summary: Hold the order: picking refuses it until the hold is lifted
put.description: Picking answers 409 ORDER_CHANNEL_HOLD {reason, holdBy} and the work queue skips the order. A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

delete.description: A no-op when not held. A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

post.summary: Book a return or refund the channel made
post.description: Idempotent on (order, returnId). Lines by lineId, externalLineId or sku; restock (default true) puts the goods back. 400 CHANNEL_ORDER_RETURN_INVALID {field, reason, index}. A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

post.summary: Complete the order by the RFID EPCs on its lines
post.description: Stock-out, tags sold and DONE in one transaction; 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_EPC_REJECTED {reason, detail} writes nothing. A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

post.summary: Channel order action: confirm
post.description: PENDING to PROCESSING (stock reserved when the tenant reserves imported orders). A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

post.summary: Channel order action: cancel
post.description: CANCELLED with `reason`: open pick lists cancelled, held or picked stock restored. A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

post.summary: Channel order action: paid
post.description: Payment status paid (partial when `amountPaid` is below the total), `paidAt` optional. A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

post.summary: Channel order action: shipped
post.description: SHIPPED with `trackingNumber`/`trackingCarrier`; `fulfillmentStatus: fulfilled` posts the stock-out when the channel shipped without a Sense pick. A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

post.summary: Channel order action: delivered
post.description: DELIVERED. A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

post.summary: Channel order action: complete
post.description: DONE. A stale If-Match / expectedVersion answers 409 CHANNEL_ORDER_VERSION_CONFLICT {currentVersion}; the answer's ETag is the order's version. App keys only (403 CHANNEL_ORDER_APP_ONLY), scope orders:write.

get.summary: Absolute stock levels per product and warehouse
get.description: On hand, reserved, available and incoming per (product, warehouse) cell, with the version stock.levels_changed carries. Filter by productIds (a master's id covers its variants) and warehouseIds; page in version order with cursor (or start from updatedSince). Levels lag the ledger by at most a few seconds.

put.summary: Upsert up to 100 products by external id
put.description: Body {items: [{externalProductId, product}]}, each product as PUT /by-external/:externalProductId takes it. Items run in order and independently; the answer lists each item's outcome.

put.summary: Upsert up to 100 customers by code
put.description: Body {items: [{code, customer}]}, each customer as PUT /by-code/:code takes it. Items run in order and independently; the answer lists each item's outcome.

get.summary: The calling app's external id links
get.description: The app's own map of partner ids to local ids for one `resource` (any name matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{1,31}$). `externalIds` or `localIds` (comma-separated, at most 200) look links up; neither lists them all by external id, `limit` (at most 500, default 500) per page, continued with `cursor` = nextCursor. 400 PUBLIC_BULK_INVALID {field, reason}.

put.summary: Save external id links
put.description: Upserts {items:[{resource, externalId, localId}]} (at most 500). A local id is linked to one external id per resource: saving it under a new external id moves it. Answers {saved}.

get.summary: The built-in integration the calling app runs
get.description: For a first-party app that replaced a built-in integration (apps-developer-guide.md section 27): {provider, mode, primary}. primary tells whether that integration is the workspace's primary catalog provider: only the primary channel writes the catalog. provider is null for any other app.

get.summary: Products by exact SKU or barcode
get.description: Every product (masters and variants, active or not) whose sku is one of `sku` or whose barcode is one of `barcode` (comma-separated, at most 100 each): {data:[{id, title, sku, barcode, externalProductId, externalVariantId, masterProductId, baseUnitOfMeasure, categoryId, isActive, allowSales, inactiveByCategory}]}. Exact and uncached, unlike the search list.

post.summary: Record the partner's stock levels (app keys)
post.description: Records {items:[{productId, warehouseId, quantity, at?}]} (at most 500) as remote stock snapshots of external system app-<handle>, written only when the quantity changed. The ledger is never written. Each item answers recorded, unchanged or failed (with the error body).

post.summary: Store Circa credentials captured by Nextwaves Agent
post.description: Circa authenticates with an SSO bearer and exposes no client-credentials grant, so the token has to come from a signed-in browser session. This lets the extension hand it over instead of an operator copying it out of DevTools, and is also how an expired token is renewed. Requires a write-scope API key. The extension sends only the POS origin, POS id and bearer — never the operator's password or cookies. The channel is not enabled here: an operator still turns it on in Settings.

post.summary: Record a POS sale from its scanned tags and stock it out
post.description: Circa sends no webhooks, so the extension reports each order the POS writes with the tags scanned onto it. Body: orderId, warehouseId (required: the POS's warehouse; the sale is stocked out there, never at the connection's default), epcs and tags [{epc, quantity}] with quantity in base units. Every tag must sit in warehouseId (else 400 RFID_TAG_WAREHOUSE_MISMATCH), an order already recorded stays in its warehouse (400 STOCK_OUT_ORDER_WAREHOUSE_MISMATCH), an unknown warehouse is 404 WAREHOUSE_NOT_FOUND, and a quantity above what a tag holds is 400 CIRCA_ORDER_QUANTITY_EXCEEDS_TAG. Requires a write-scope API key whose owner can reach warehouseId.

get.summary: Whether Circa QR lookup is set up
get.description: integrated is true while the Circa connection is enabled; enabled is true when a QR lookup source (Buymed RFID QR API or Circa v2) is configured as well.

get.summary: Look up a Circa QR label
get.description: code is the label's code or URL. warehouseId (optional) uses that warehouse's Buymed customer. Answers the Circa product id, the matched local product and unit, UID, batch and expiry. 400 INTEGRATION_NOT_CONFIGURED without a lookup source, 400 CIRCA_QR_INVALID for an unreadable code, 404 CIRCA_QR_NOT_FOUND for an unknown label.

get.summary: List Circa product mappings (paginated)
get.description: Each Circa product id with the local product it stands for and its units: base unit first (ratio 1), then each sales unit with how many base units it holds. Filter by circaProductId or productId.

get.summary: Get the product a Circa product id maps to
get.description: 404 CIRCA_PRODUCT_NOT_MAPPED when the id has no link.

put.summary: Link a Circa product id to a product (requires write scope)
put.description: Creates the link or moves it to another product. A master product or a kit cannot be linked (400 CIRCA_PRODUCT_NOT_LINKABLE); a product already linked to another Circa id answers 409 CIRCA_PRODUCT_ALREADY_MAPPED.

delete.summary: Remove a Circa product link (requires write scope)
delete.description: 404 CIRCA_PRODUCT_NOT_MAPPED when the id has no link.

post.summary: Map EPCs to product, unit and base quantity (read scope)
post.description: 1 to 500 EPCs, answered in request order. Each answer gives the tag's product, Circa product id, sales unit and its ratio, what the tag holds now in base units (a pack's remainder, an opened tag's unit quantity), lot, expiry and warehouse. found is false for an unknown EPC.

get.summary: Map one EPC to product, unit and base quantity
get.description: Never 404s: found is false when no tag has the EPC. EPC matching ignores case and surrounding whitespace.

get.summary: List hub orders (paginated)
get.description: Newest first. status filters on the purchase order status.

get.summary: Get a hub order with its lines, expected EPCs and receipts
get.description: 404 CIRCA_HUB_ORDER_NOT_FOUND.

put.summary: Create or replace a hub sales order as a confirmed purchase order (requires write scope)
put.description: The hub's sales order becomes a CONFIRMED purchase order on the hub's supplier; the EPCs it shipped are stored as expected units, one of the line's unit each. Nothing is stocked until the store receives by scan. Replacing is allowed until the first receipt (then 409 CIRCA_HUB_ORDER_LOCKED). Runs as the API key's owner.

post.summary: Receive a hub order by scan (requires write scope)
post.description: Scanned EPCs and label UIDs receive their units once; anything not on the order is recorded as unexpected and never stocked. Untagged quantities default to the whole remainder. One stock-in against the purchase order is created and confirmed as the key owner, in one transaction. keep_open leaves missing units expected; close_short marks them missing and closes the purchase order short.

post.summary: Cancel a hub order (requires write scope)
post.description: Cancels the purchase order while nothing has been received (else 409 CIRCA_HUB_ORDER_LOCKED); its EPCs are freed for other orders.

post.summary: Find the purchase orders Circa purchase orders stand for (read scope)
post.description: Up to 100 Circa purchase orders by id (circaId) and code. Each is matched by its Circa id mapping, else by a pulled Circa purchase order with that code. Only rows found are answered, with the purchase order's number, status, received percent and, when FRONTEND_URL is set, its page url.
